tools.name: p4
tools.$comment: Perforce Helix Core CLI (p4) -- the client p4-kit's code review drives. p4-kit is the declared owner (analysis row 29 / step 14; env-config's install-perforce.sh custom-install machinery is retired). unreal-kit ALSO declares p4, deliberately, with a fulfillment-identical entry -- both plugins genuinely need the client and neither should force the other's install. Any change to this entry's check/install must be mirrored in unreal-kit/bootstrap.json. macOS: brew cask p4 (the Helix command-line client cask; casks are trusted on install exit per the audited ruling). Windows: scoop main/p4. Ubuntu: Perforce apt repo (keyring + source) then `helix-cli`, elevated (verbatim the form audited in env-config Wave A). CLI only -- P4V/p4merge/p4admin GUI provisioning is dropped (the analysis delegates only the p4 CLI to p4-kit). check keys on p4 because the binary name differs from the package/cask name.

ubuntu.command: wget -qO - https://package.perforce.com/perforce.pubkey | gpg --dearmor | sudo tee /usr/share/keyrings/perforce.gpg > /dev/null && echo 'deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/perforce.gpg] https://package.perforce.com/apt/ubuntu noble release' | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/perforce.list && sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y helix-cli
